results.content: KnowWhere uses PostgreSQL with pgvector extension as its primary database for vector storage and metadata.
KnowWhere stores decisions, semantic memories, and episodic sessions with automatic type-tagging.
KnowWhere uses Ollama with snowflake-arctic-embed2 model producing 768-dimensional embeddings.
KnowWhere is built in Rust using the Axum 0.8 web framework with Tokio async runtime.
KnowWhere follows a pointer-first fractal memory architecture with L0→L1→L2 consolidation tiers.
KnowWhere supports the Agent Memory Benchmark (AMB) via the omb Python toolkit for standardized evaluation.
KnowWhere's server listens on port 3737 by default and uses Bearer token authentication.
